primary.$description: Canonical product blue. Ratified 2026-07-23: kept at the value already live in all 5 apps rather than migrating to the brand guide's value — see color.brand.blue for that.

500.$description: Base primary. Confirmed identical across all 5 apps.

secondary.$description: Product gold/amber accent. Note: differs slightly from color.brand.gold (#FBD24D vs #FBD249) — a pre-existing 2-value drift between brand guide and code, kept separate rather than silently merged.

500.$description: Base secondary. Confirmed identical across all 5 apps.

neutral.$description: Renamed from the code's 'pneutral' — no known reason for the 'p' prefix, dropped during ratification.

750.$description: New — a real, heavily-used gray that was completely undocumented until this audit. Confirmed via live Figma design context as the actual secondary/body text color in Breadcrumb, Tab, Table Header, Table Content Cell, Pagination, Side Nav Item, Tooltip description, Button Group, Button Tertiary, Accordion description, and more (13+ distinct components) — used more often than neutral-700 itself. Sits between neutral-700 (#4F4F4F) and neutral-800 (#2E2E2E); named '750' to reflect that position, not an official Figma variable name (none existed for it).

destructive.$description: 800 fixed to the standard Tailwind red-800 value. All 5 apps had 800 and 900 set to the identical value (#7F1D1D) — a copy-paste bug, not an intentional shade.

brand.$description: Brand-identity colors, for marketing/document contexts (matches tahche-brand.skill). Not for product UI — use color.primary / color.secondary there.

blue.$description: 'Tahche Blue' per the brand guide. Kept distinct from color.primary.500 (#353DD7) by design — see decisions log.
